339-677-6495-7296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3179-4399-4770-5789.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Lifecreed Duo trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4770-5789.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1619-4605-5542-5686-6144.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6144.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Goliath Paladin from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Goliath Paladin enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Goliath Paladin.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Goliath Paladin token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6144.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

222-527-2921-5434.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2921-5434.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

6649-7428.notablePrerequisites: Aettir and Priwen attached to a creature you control that has lifelink, doesn't have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
6649-7428.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature with Aettir and Priwen attached, doubling your life total due to its lifelink.
At the beginning of your end step, Defiling Daemogoth triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you've lost this turn.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-2554-7377.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Third Path Iconoclast
1618-2440-2554-7377.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Festering March.
Festering March triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Third Path Iconoclast triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Festering March.
Repeat.
1618-2440-2554-7377.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Third Path Iconoclast. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

550-1618-2440-3019.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Young Pyromancer
550-1618-2440-3019.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Inspiring Refrain.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Young Pyromancer triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain.
Repeat.
550-1618-2440-3019.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Young Pyromancer. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

38-248-1869.description:
Cast Changeling Berserker by paying {3}{R}.
Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Inalla.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Changeling Berserker with haste.
The token Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Changeling Berserker.
The nontoken Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, returning nothing from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Changeling Berserker trigger from step 2, choosing not to exile anything.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing the Mistbind Clique token, adding at least {C}.
The Changeling Berserker token leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Changeling Berserker from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7236.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Towering Titan.
When Towering Titan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

2893-3875-4500-6664.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Retreat to Kazandu trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using one colored mana

717-2628-6100--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {1} and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Bone Miser's second ability trigger.
Resolve Bone Miser's ability, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Elvish Regrower.
When Elvish Regrower enters, it triggers, returning the cycled land from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
717-2628-6100--38.notes: You can discard down to maximum hand size at end of turn to trigger Bone Miser's abilities many times.

283-2775-5231-6705.description:
Activate Slimefoot by paying {4}.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Slimefoot's ability.
Resolve both Slimefoot abilities, creating four creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing the four creature tokens, adding {4}.
When the creature tokens die, Slimefoot triggers four times, dealing 4 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat

527-542-4927.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-4927.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1879-2105-3204-4364.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1879-2105-3204-4364.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

5080-6285.notablePrerequisites: You have not activated Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability.
5080-6285.description:
Cast Maddening Cacophony with kicker by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each opponent to mill half their library, rounded up.
Activate Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it, causing each opponent to mill the remainder of their library.

1778-2232-3652-6134.notablePrerequisites: One of the creatures with mana value 0 must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.
1778-2232-3652-6134.description:
Cast the creature with mana value 0 from your hand by paying {0}.
Rendmaw triggers, causing each player to create a tapped 2/2 Bird creature token.
When the Bird enters the battlefield under your control, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning a nontoken creature with mana value 0 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Repeat.

2557-2793-3743-5089-5437.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2557-2793-3743-5089-5437.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

1274-3490-5231-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-5231-5870.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

511-817-1887-4050-4094.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
511-817-1887-4050-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

671-1339-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
671-1339-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

3221-3283-5541.notablePrerequisites: Bazaar Trader does not have summoning sickness.
3221-3283-5541.description:
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, giving control of Notion Thief to an opponent.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Consecrated Sphinx triggers, causing the opponent to draw two cards due to Notion Thief.
Consecrated Sphinx triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, causing the opponent to draw two cards due to Notion Thief.
Repeat from step 4 until the opponent loses the game due to drawing from an empty library.

1770-4636-5159.description:
At the beginning of combat, Mishra triggers, creating a 4/4 artifact creature token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart named Mishra's Warform.
When Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, it and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger twice each, causing you to get eight {E}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying eight {E} and exiling it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2585-4832-4893.notablePrerequisites:
Ensoul Artifact attached to Grim Monolith.
Grim Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
2585-4832-4893.description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Grim Monolith's second ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3368-3407.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R}{R}, plus an additional {R} if Dual Strike was not foretold, plus enough mana to cast the additional spell if needed
3368-3407.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cast an additional instant or sorcery, or an opponent is casting one.
3368-3407.description:
Cast any other instant and/or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Dual Strike by paying {R}{R}, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast with mana value four or less.
Cast Reiterate by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting the instant or sorcery spell cast in step 1.
Dual Strike triggers, copying Reiterate, with the copy targeting the original Reiterate.
Resolve the copy of Reiterate, copying Reiterate, with the copy targeting the original Reiterate.
Repeat step 5.
